summary: Child can claim parent ownership during first pairing
evidence: The pairing code is displayed on the child PC and the first caller to /setup chooses the parent password; no existing parent credential is required.
fix_plan: Replace child-known bootstrap secret with parent-authenticated enrollment using a parent passkey/session and a device public key; make enrollment single-use and rate-limited.

summary: Known default PIN can disable or uninstall protection
evidence: An unset PIN resolves to 123456; pairing does not replace it, while tray disable and cleaner authorization accept the effective PIN.
fix_plan: Remove child-side reusable emergency PIN as a protection bypass; require authenticated parent-device maintenance and a high-entropy offline recovery method.

summary: Privileged enforcement is an interactive per-user process, not a Windows service
evidence: Guard requires admin rights but starts through HKCU and an interactive ONLOGON scheduled task tied to the installing user; this conflicts with a separate standard child account and is stoppable architecture.
fix_plan: Move privileged policy and state ownership to a LocalSystem Windows service; keep a separate per-session child UI communicating through ACL-restricted named pipes.

summary: Web default-deny is bypassable and only reacts after a supported browser exposes its address bar
evidence: The implementation uses UI Automation for a small process-name list, ignores IP literals, and kills the browser only after seeing an unknown domain.
fix_plan: Use managed browser policy/extension plus network egress controls; block every unmanaged browser and VPN/proxy path by application policy.

summary: AppLocker baseline leaves documented application-control bypass hosts available
evidence: The policy calls New-AppLockerPolicy -AllowWindows and denies only a short local list; it omits many Microsoft-documented bypass applications, packaged-app rules and DLL policy.
fix_plan: Generate a versioned least-privilege policy from Microsoft guidance, cover packaged apps/scripts/installers and bypass hosts, and evaluate signed App Control for Business for high-assurance mode.

summary: Parent cabinet sends credentials, sessions and child activity over LAN HTTP
evidence: The listener binds http://+ and cookies cannot be Secure; setup/login have no brute-force throttling, request-size cap, CSRF token or trusted-host/origin validation.
fix_plan: Retire LAN password auth in favor of outbound TLS to a secure parent controller; until retirement bind locally or use HTTPS, CSRF, rate limits and strict request limits.

summary: State storage is non-atomic, same-user scoped and replayable
evidence: State is written directly to three CurrentUser-DPAPI files with swallowed errors; the child profile can own writable copies and concurrent server/timer saves can corrupt or roll back policy.
fix_plan: Make the service the sole state owner; store under ProgramData with SYSTEM/admin ACLs, atomic replace, authenticated schema/version and monotonic anti-rollback metadata.

summary: Installer and all shipped executables are unsigned and there is no CI release gate
evidence: Authenticode inspection reports NotSigned for installer, guard, helper and cleaner; the repository has no GitHub workflow.
fix_plan: Add Authenticode signing, reproducible CI build/test/package gates, signed update manifests, staged rollout and verified rollback.

summary: Known Windows admin-account recovery bypass is not prevented by setup
evidence: Current setup can demote the child but does not require a separate offline local parent admin, remove the parent Microsoft account, or continuously detect administrator-group drift.
fix_plan: Add a setup security check and ongoing invariant monitor for local parent admin, standard child account, admin-group membership, BitLocker/Secure Boot and recovery-key ownership.

summary: Remote parent approval over the internet is not implemented
evidence: The current parent cabinet is explicitly LAN-only, so the requested child-to-parent approval flow fails whenever the parent is outside the home network.
fix_plan: Add an outbound-only device connection to an HTTPS cloud relay and a passkey-protected parent PWA with push notifications that contain no secrets.

summary: Parent experience is a long settings page instead of a request-first workflow
evidence: Requests, manual blocklists, PIN, Windows accounts, AppLocker paths, limits and tasks are rendered in one 760px page; parents must type executable paths and repeatedly enter a password.
fix_plan: Make Pending Requests the home screen, use one-tap scoped approvals, move advanced controls behind persistent navigation, and eliminate manual paths from normal use.

summary: Russian/English localization is incomplete and ad hoc
evidence: The cabinet has paired strings, but pairing content is mostly Russian, cleaner and installer are English-only, and technical flows bypass localization resources.
fix_plan: Adopt resource-based RU/EN localization across installer, setup, child UI, recovery and parent UI; make Russian the default and add localization tests.

summary: Green unit harness does not test the security-critical Windows behavior
evidence: All 35 checks pass, but there are no VM end-to-end tests for service startup, AppLocker enforcement, browser bypasses, account recovery, installer, restart, safe mode or tamper recovery.
fix_plan: Build a Windows VM matrix with scripted attack scenarios, integration adapters, installer/upgrade/rollback tests and release-blocking security acceptance gates.
